scrolls.scope: Exact here means this, and only this. Two finer scans of PHerc0139 agree on the recto face within 1 voxel at 238 of 370 drawn code 0 (snapped) sites (64.3%, lower bound 60.0%). On those sites, 226 of 238 snapped vertices lie within 1 label voxel of that face (95.0%, lower bound 92.0%). It is not every vertex: about 36% of drawn code 0 sites are not covered by the two scans and make no claim, and codes 1 and 2 (left in place and filled) are outside it. It is one scroll and one band of the label scan (z 5384 to 5869). Agreement with two scans cannot see an error both scans share, so it is not proof that a vertex lies on the papyrus. Against the 1.129 µm scan alone the same sites are Not shown.
